notes.title: More facial expression controls
notes.content:
Thank you for your support of our game. We have added some new features in this update to make you more enjoyable in the game!

1. The main scene has added a facial expression selection function, and now you can freely choose your partner's facial expression.
2. The volume control function has been added, and now you can control the volume of the music of the concert and the ambient sound in the rain scene. 
3. Fixed bugs reported by players.
 
Thank you for your support and feedback, we will continue to update and optimize the game content to bring you a better gaming experience! Don't forget to share this update with your Steam friends!

notes.title: Optimize avertar generation
notes.content:
1. Further optimized facial expressions.
2. Fixed the problem that some countries and regions failed to generate avatars before.
  Now the avatar generation function can be used normally in these countries and regions.

notes.title: Major update —— She can smile now!
notes.content:
1. Added a variety of facial expressions, so that the character's face is no longer stiff
2. Fixed bugs reported by players.

notes.title: Major update - New sexy body added!
notes.content:
1. Added a new super-sexy body,, which you can create a better 3D Lover.
2. A lot of new outfits have been added to the store. More choices for you to dress up your 3D Lover.
3. Added precreated-avatar, players can use the this avatar to create characters.

notes.title: a regular update
notes.content:
1. Add voice chat function, you can directly talk with your exclusive 3D lover voice, there are various beautiful female voices!
2. An interesting teasing game is added in the Desktop MMD Mode. You can have more fun interacting with your exclusive 3D lover
3. Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: small update
Small updates
